radiusSource: Radius 0.56 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Mann et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1227 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..156M/abstract): 389,592 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
